scripts.cf:build: opennextjs-cloudflare build --config wrangler.jsonc && opennextjs-cloudflare populateCache local --config wrangler.jsonc && node scripts/cloudflare-check.mjs artifacts
scripts.cf:check: opennextjs-cloudflare populateCache local --config wrangler.jsonc && node scripts/cloudflare-check.mjs production
scripts.cf:preview: opennextjs-cloudflare build --config wrangler.jsonc && opennextjs-cloudflare preview --config wrangler.jsonc --port 3200
scripts.cf:preview:check: opennextjs-cloudflare populateCache local --config wrangler.jsonc && node scripts/cloudflare-check.mjs preview
scripts.cf:preview:deploy: opennextjs-cloudflare populateCache local --config wrangler.jsonc && node scripts/cloudflare-check.mjs artifacts && wrangler preview --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cf:deploy: opennextjs-cloudflare build --config wrangler.jsonc && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
